  abstract: |
    The Little Book of Discrete Event Simulation (DES) is a free eBook written to accompany the DES module of the Health Service Modelling Associates (HSMA) programme. DES is a technique used for building simulations of pathways and services, allowing 'what-if' questions to be tested. The book takes you from being a complete beginner in DES through to creating complex models with a web interface. This Python resource primarily focusses on the SimPy package, also touching on Streamlit and various supporting packages.

This ebook covers 15 modules (at the time of writing) on how to make better decisions with data.

> The series is designed to support:
>
> - analysts
> - operational leaders
> - clinicians
> - managers
> - decision-makers
>
> in developing a stronger understanding of:
>
> - healthcare metrics
> - variation
> - benchmarking
> - inequalities
> - operational performance
> - population health
> - analytical fairness and interpretation"

The ebook is accompanied by a [companion app](https://ckaur5689.github.io/DecisionIntelligence/) to support readers in finding the most relevant content for their particular question or area of interest.
